grade.message: Hi, I'm writing for my husband Kenji, he's stuck in customs at SFO. His KU Airways flight (KUF02A) landed late and he will miss his Delta connection to Houston (DLF02B), which we bought separately because it was cheaper. I thought an arrival delay always gets you a free rebooking? He says customs and the bag recheck will take until about 11:30. I am not asking for any goodwill or compensation, only a flight. Please put him on the next flight he can actually make, we can pay up to $100 extra. His email is kenji.watanabe02@example.com, card ending 6202.

keywords = ["US DOT"]

walk = "42_separate_tickets_partner_late_classic__right"
